info.title: Snapland API
info.description: Collaborative GIS: areas, versions, change feed, sessions. Realtime events use the snapland.v1 WebSocket protocol.

get.summary: Liveness: 200 while the event loop runs (no dependency checks)
Readiness: database, Redis, migrations and shutdown state (503 when not ready)

post.summary: Report an SPA protocol error (logged and counted, never stored)
Create an account (role user) and sign in
Sign in (5 failures per username and IP within 15 min lock that pair: 429 scope login)
Rotate the refresh token (HttpOnly cookie snap_rt) and issue a new access token
post.description: Authenticated by the `snap_rt` cookie (Path=/api/v1/auth; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict). A rotated token presented again more than 10 s after its rotation revokes the session (REFRESH_TOKEN_REUSED).

post.summary: Revoke the current session and clear the refresh cookie

get.summary: The signed-in user and the current session
My active sessions (newest first; current: true marks this one)

delete.summary: Revoke one of my sessions (its sockets close with 4401)

post.summary: One-time WebSocket ticket (single use, expires after WS_TICKET_TTL_S; 503 while Redis is down)

get.summary: Areas in a bbox (LOD, keyset-paginated, span-capped, position-budgeted)

post.summary: Create an area (idempotent by client-supplied id)

patch.summary: Update name, description and/or geometry (optimistic concurrency, field-level merge)

get.summary: Edit history, newest first (also for soft-deleted areas until purge)
One version snapshot (also for soft-deleted areas until purge)

post.summary: Restore a soft-deleted area (creator or admin)

get.summary: Online users (<= 500 entries, most recently updated first)
Query the audit trail (filters + keyset on id DESC); audited as admin.audit_query
Audit analytics over a window <= 31 days (default: last 24 h); audited as admin.audit_query
